AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Average Student
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a Tokiwano average student. She does not need a description at all.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Music Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of a Tokiwano music club. She dreams of being a lead singer.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Baseball Player
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a Tokiwano baseball player. Her team has won the national campaign for five consecutive years.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Garden Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of a Tokiwano garden club. Her favourite are Stargazers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Cat Cafe
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as an employee of a cat cafe.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Sculpture Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of Tokiwano sculpture club. Her best work is Sweat No.2VOPN. This piece bears an illustration of a missile. If you squint your eyes, the unbalanced composition of the image reveals the outline of a gourd.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Cooking Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of Tokiwano cooking club. The club gets really busy before Valentine day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Karate Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of Tokiwano karate club. She likes to have some juice after practice.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Outing Club
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a member of Tokiwano outing club. She should have bypassed the camp of the cannibal tribe.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Student Association
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] acts as a representative of a Tokiwano student association. Her duty is to enforce the discipline of the Tokiwano.
